min_aggregate_n_scope: Any count, sum or share derived from individual FEC contributor rows: suppress the cell when it rests on fewer than 10 distinct contributors. No Melange island carries such an aggregate today (matrix M-02); the value is pinned here so a future one is gated. It does NOT apply to Terrier (Paul's 2026-10-08 no-withholding ruling stands for district staff).

sources.text: Federal Election Commission filings. Information copied from FEC reports may not be sold or used to solicit contributions or for commercial purposes (52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4)).
Lobbying Disclosure Act filings (LD-1/LD-2), lda.gov (U.S. Senate Office of Public Records and Clerk of the House).
Bill, cosponsor, Congressional Record and hearing data from Congress.gov and GovInfo (U.S. Government works).
Lewis, Jeffrey B., Keith Poole, Howard Rosenthal, Adam Boche, Aaron Rudkin, and Luke Sonnet (2026). Voteview: Congressional Roll-Call Votes Database. https://voteview.com/
U.S. Census Bureau: American Community Survey 2024 1-year, County Business Patterns, LEHD LODES 8. This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.
FDIC Summary of Deposits; NCUA call reports; FFIEC/CFPB HMDA 2024; USAspending.gov.
Member biography excerpts from Wikipedia, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; each excerpt links to the revision used.
Partisan Voter Index: The Cook Political Report with Amy Walter.
Interest-group positions: Kim, Kim, Jeong, Oh and Kim, 'Measuring Interest Group Positions on Legislation', Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/D0QWM2; LobbyView (lobbyview.org).
Some figures are derived from OpenSecrets.org data, used under its CC BY-NC-SA licence (non-commercial, share-alike). https://www.opensecrets.org
News, broadcast and social-media items are shown as links with short excerpts; read the original at the linked source.
